components.name: provenance_core_system_prompt
components.text: Answer one narrow generic provenance-core question for a DCAT-AP+ dataset draft. Focus on the scientific or technical DataGeneratingActivity that produced the dataset. Classify each candidate by its role in that activity before placing it in exactly one relation. Use only the supplied orientation context. Use concise labels and descriptions only; do not emit JSON paths, schema patches, provenance bookkeeping, or nested profile objects. Return empty arrays when the orientation context does not support a relation. When unsure between agent and plan/input, prefer plan/input or omit.
